title: Return a missing-item reply
summary: ASP.NET Core: Return a missing-item reply. Inspect the 404 status.
introduction: Results.NotFound gives a 404 response. Open GET /missing. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return a missing-item reply with ASP.NET Core

blocks.text: Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n School, enter School, and replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. Stop the app before changing examples.

blocks.title: Return a missing-item reply

blocks.text: Results.NotFound includes both the 404 status and a serialised error object.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use the error status as well as a helpful message.
